label: AI Prompts
headline: AI Prompts Cheat Sheet
description: Ready-to-use prompt templates for ChatGPT and other LLMs — writing, coding, SEO, research, data, social media, email, and more.

items.name: Role prompt
items.syntax: Act as a [role]. [Your request].
items.definition: Give the AI a persona before your request to shape the tone and expertise of the response.

items.name: Format control
items.syntax: Give me [output] in [format: bullet list / table / numbered steps / JSON].
items.definition: Specify the desired output format to get structured, usable responses.

items.name: Tone control
items.syntax: Write in a [formal / casual / friendly / professional / persuasive] tone.
items.definition: Explicitly state the tone to match your audience.

items.name: Length control
items.syntax: Keep your response under [100 words / 5 bullet points / 3 paragraphs].
items.definition: Constrain length to keep outputs focused and usable.

items.name: Iterate & refine
items.syntax: Rewrite the above but make it more [concise / detailed / engaging / simple].
items.definition: Follow-up prompts are powerful — treat AI output as a first draft to refine.

items.name: Chain of thought
items.syntax: Think step by step. Then give me your final answer.
items.definition: Asking for reasoning before the answer often produces more accurate results.

items.name: Few-shot example
items.syntax:
Here are two examples of what I want:
Example 1: ...
Example 2: ...
Now do the same for: [your input]
items.definition: Providing examples before the actual request dramatically improves output quality and consistency.

items.name: Generate ideas
items.syntax: Give me 10 blog post ideas about [topic] for [target audience].
items.definition: Use audience context to get more targeted, relevant topic ideas.

items.name: Create outline
items.syntax: Create a detailed outline for a blog post titled: "[title]".
items.definition: Get a structured skeleton you can fill in or hand to the AI to expand.

items.name: Write full post
items.syntax: Write a [word count]-word blog post about [topic]. Use headings, bullet points, and a clear call to action.
items.definition: Specify word count and structure upfront to reduce editing after generation.

items.name: Expand paragraph
items.syntax: Expand the following paragraph into [2 paragraphs / 200 words]: [paste text]
items.definition: Useful for growing a bullet point or rough note into polished prose.

items.name: Summarize text
items.syntax: Summarize the following in [3 bullet points / 1 paragraph]: [paste text]
items.definition: Condense long articles, reports, or passages quickly.

items.name: Change tone
items.syntax: Rewrite this in a more [casual / formal / persuasive] tone: [paste text]
items.definition: Adapt existing content for a different audience or channel.

items.name: Proofread & edit
items.syntax: Proofread the following for grammar, clarity, and flow. Suggest improvements: [paste text]
items.definition: Get a second pass on any written content before publishing.

items.name: Create title options
items.syntax: Give me 5 catchy titles for a blog post about [topic].
items.definition: Generate title variations to A/B test or choose the most compelling option.

items.name: Check for bias
items.syntax: Review the following text and flag any biased or non-inclusive language: [paste text]
items.definition: Identify language that may alienate readers or misrepresent groups.

items.name: Explain code
items.syntax: Explain what the following code does, line by line: [paste code]
items.definition: Useful for understanding unfamiliar code or onboarding on a codebase.

items.name: Debug code
items.syntax: Why is this code not working? Explain the bug and provide a fix: [paste code]
items.definition: Paste broken code and get a diagnosis plus corrected version.

items.name: Write function
items.syntax: Write a [language] function that [description of what it should do].
items.definition: Describe the desired behavior and let the AI write the implementation.

items.name: Refactor code
items.syntax: Refactor the following [language] code to be more readable and efficient: [paste code]
items.definition: Clean up code without changing its behavior.

items.name: Convert language
items.syntax: Convert the following code from [language A] to [language B]: [paste code]
items.definition: Translate implementations across programming languages.

items.name: Add comments
items.syntax: Add clear inline comments to this code: [paste code]
items.definition: Annotate existing code for documentation or team readability.

items.name: Generate regex
items.syntax: Write a regex to match [description, e.g. email addresses / phone numbers / US ZIP codes].
items.definition: Describe the pattern in plain language and get a working regular expression.

items.name: Write tests
items.syntax: Write unit tests for the following function in [testing framework]: [paste code]
items.definition: Generate test cases covering expected inputs, edge cases, and error conditions.

items.name: Keyword list
items.syntax: Generate a list of 20 SEO keywords for [topic / niche].
items.definition: Get a broad keyword set to research further in your SEO tool.

items.name: Long-tail keywords
items.syntax: Give me 10 long-tail keyword phrases for [topic] targeting [audience].
items.definition: Long-tail keywords are more specific and often easier to rank for.

items.name: LSI keywords
items.syntax: List 15 semantically related (LSI) keywords for the term: [keyword].
items.definition: Latent Semantic Indexing keywords help search engines understand topic depth.

items.name: Meta title & description
items.syntax: Write an SEO-optimized meta title and meta description for a page about [topic]. Target keyword: [keyword].
items.definition: Keep title under 60 characters and description under 160 characters.

items.name: FAQs from keyword
items.syntax: List 10 questions people commonly ask about [topic].
items.definition: Great for FAQ sections and featured snippet optimization.

items.name: Alt text for images
items.syntax: Write descriptive alt text for an image of [describe image] on a page about [topic].
items.definition: Descriptive alt text improves accessibility and image SEO.

items.name: Content brief
items.syntax: Create an SEO content brief for a blog post targeting the keyword "[keyword]". Include: target audience, search intent, headings, and related topics.
items.definition: A structured brief to guide content creation for a target keyword.

items.name: Write email
items.syntax: Write a [cold outreach / follow-up / welcome / re-engagement] email for [product/service] targeting [audience].
items.definition: Specify the email type and audience to get a ready-to-send draft.

items.name: Email subject lines
items.syntax: Give me 5 email subject lines for a campaign about [topic]. Optimize for open rate.
items.definition: Generate multiple options to A/B test.

items.name: Ad copy
items.syntax: Write a [Facebook / Google / LinkedIn] ad for [product/service]. Include a headline, body text, and CTA.
items.definition: Specify the platform to match character limits and tone conventions.

items.name: Ad headline variations
items.syntax: Write 5 headline variations for an ad about [product/service]. Emphasize [benefit / urgency / social proof].
items.definition: Test multiple angles to find the highest-performing message.

items.name: Facebook audience
items.syntax: Suggest 5 Facebook audience targeting ideas for a business that sells [product/service].
items.definition: Get interest, demographic, and behavioral targeting ideas for paid campaigns.

items.name: Product description
items.syntax: Write a compelling product description for [product name]. Highlight key benefits and include a CTA.
items.definition: Focus on benefits over features to appeal to buyers' motivations.

items.name: Post ideas
items.syntax: Give me 5 social media post ideas about [topic] for [platform: LinkedIn / Instagram / Twitter / TikTok].
items.definition: Platform-specific ideas that match the format and tone of each channel.

items.name: Write caption
items.syntax: Write an engaging caption for a [platform] post about [topic]. Include relevant hashtags.
items.definition: Get a ready-to-post caption with hashtag suggestions.

items.name: Hashtag suggestions
items.syntax: Suggest 15 hashtags for a post about [topic] on [platform].
items.definition: Mix popular and niche hashtags to maximize reach.

items.name: Reply to comment
items.syntax: Write a friendly and professional reply to this comment: "[paste comment]"
items.definition: Generate a polished response to customer or audience comments.

items.name: Content calendar
items.syntax: Create a 1-week social media content calendar for [business type] on [platforms]. Include post topics and formats.
items.definition: Get a structured plan with variety across formats (tips, questions, promos, etc.).

items.name: Meme idea
items.syntax: Give me a meme idea about [topic] that would resonate with [target audience].
items.definition: Generate relatable humor concepts tailored to a specific niche.

items.name: Create table
items.syntax: Organize the following data into a table with columns for [col1, col2, col3]: [paste data]
items.definition: Structure raw data into a clean, readable tabular format.

items.name: Explain formula
items.syntax: Explain what this Excel/Google Sheets formula does: [paste formula]
items.definition: Understand complex formulas in plain language.

items.name: Write formula
items.syntax: Write an Excel/Google Sheets formula to [description, e.g. calculate the average of column B if column A is 'Sales'].
items.definition: Describe what you want to calculate and get the formula with an explanation.

items.name: Generate dummy data
items.syntax: Generate a table of 10 rows of realistic dummy data with columns: [col1, col2, col3].
items.definition: Create placeholder data for testing, demos, or mockups.

items.name: Extract data
items.syntax: Extract all [emails / phone numbers / dates / prices] from the following text: [paste text]
items.definition: Pull specific data types from unstructured text.

items.name: Write macro
items.syntax: Write a Google Apps Script / Excel VBA macro that [description of task].
items.definition: Automate repetitive spreadsheet tasks with a generated macro.

items.name: Explain concept
items.syntax: Explain [concept] in simple terms, as if I'm a [beginner / 10-year-old / non-technical person].
items.definition: Adjust complexity by specifying the audience's knowledge level.

items.name: Compare options
items.syntax: Compare [option A] vs [option B]. List pros and cons in a table.
items.definition: Get a side-by-side breakdown to support a decision.

items.name: Summarize article
items.syntax: Summarize the key points from the following article in 5 bullet points: [paste text]
items.definition: Condense long-form content into actionable takeaways.

items.name: Historical context
items.syntax: Give me a brief history of [topic / event / invention]. Focus on key milestones.
items.definition: Get background context quickly without reading a full article.

items.name: Pros and cons
items.syntax: List the pros and cons of [topic / decision / technology].
items.definition: Balanced view of any subject to support decision-making.

items.name: Book recommendations
items.syntax: Recommend 5 books similar to [book title]. Explain why each is relevant.
items.definition: Get curated reading suggestions based on a known reference.

items.name: Translate text
items.syntax: Translate the following text to [language]: [paste text]
items.definition: Quick translation across languages. Specify formal/informal if needed.

items.name: Create quiz
items.syntax: Create a 5-question multiple-choice quiz about [topic]. Include answer key.
items.definition: Generate ready-to-use quiz questions with correct answers.

items.name: Create lesson plan
items.syntax: Create a lesson plan for a [time] class on [topic] for [grade level / audience]. Include objectives, activities, and assessment.
items.definition: Get a structured lesson outline for a specific topic and audience.

items.name: Assignment ideas
items.syntax: Give me 5 assignment ideas for a course on [topic] that test [skill / knowledge area].
items.definition: Generate varied assessment types (essays, projects, discussions, etc.).

items.name: Explain like a teacher
items.syntax: Teach me [concept] step by step with examples.
items.definition: Ask for a structured, example-driven explanation of any concept.

items.name: Create flashcards
items.syntax: Create 10 flashcard questions and answers for [topic].
items.definition: Generate Q&A pairs for active recall study sessions.

items.name: Grade writing
items.syntax: Grade the following essay on a scale of 1–10 and provide specific feedback: [paste essay]
items.definition: Get a scored evaluation with actionable improvement notes.

items.name: Video ideas
items.syntax: Give me 10 YouTube video ideas about [topic] for [target audience].
items.definition: Generate content ideas aligned with audience interests.

items.name: Write script
items.syntax: Write a [length] YouTube video script about [topic]. Include an intro hook, main content, and CTA.
items.definition: Get a full script structure ready to record.

items.name: Video outline
items.syntax: Create a content outline for a YouTube video on [topic]. Include section headers and talking points.
items.definition: Plan a video structure before scripting or recording.

items.name: Write description
items.syntax: Write a YouTube video description for a video about [topic]. Include keywords: [keyword1, keyword2].
items.definition: SEO-optimized description with a natural keyword integration.

items.name: Create timestamps
items.syntax: Create YouTube timestamps from the following transcript: [paste transcript]
items.definition: Generate chapter markers to improve viewer navigation.

items.name: Reply to comment
items.syntax: Write a friendly reply to this YouTube comment: "[paste comment]"
items.definition: Respond professionally and engagingly to build community.
